notes.sowing: Sow outdoors from 2 weeks before your last frost up to the frost date, {cm:0.6} to {cm:1} deep, and cover the seed. For earlier flowers, start indoors 6 to 8 weeks before your last frost. Seedlings appear in 1 to 2 weeks.
notes.care: Grows in sun or part shade in average, well-drained soil; do not overfeed. Flowering slows or stops in hot weather and picks up again when it cools. Plants take frost down to about {c:-4}. Deadhead to keep flowers coming and to limit self-sowing.
notes.harvest: First flowers open about 8 weeks from sowing. Pick at full bloom every few days; new flowers follow in about two weeks. The petals are edible.
